events.title: October Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in and around Old Fort. Post-ride social at Foothills Watershed. No e-bikes allowed. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite. For all women 18 and older.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test and tune event with industry partner Cane Creek Components. For riders with suspension bikes comfortable on downhill trails with rocks and roots. No e-bikes allowed. 8 spots available, waitlist available. For all women 18 or older.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Pisgah. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery at 342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712. No e-bikes allowed. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite. For all women 18 and older.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Hot Springs. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing at 25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231. No e-bikes allowed. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite. For all women 18 and older.
